Advice for pregnant, breastfeeding and those trying to conceive is shown first. Sources: Danish Veterinary and Food Administration and EFSA.

activity.title: Activity
activity.spikeTitle: You burned {kcal} extra calories {day}. What were you doing?
activity.spikeHint: Your heart rate reached {peak} (resting {rest}) for {minutes} min.
activity.intensityHint: The talk test: how easy was it to talk along the way?
activity.kcalHintMet: Estimated from your weight and the activity's MET value ({met}). Enter your own number if your watch knows it.
activity.kcalHintSpeed: Estimated from distance, time and weight (MET {met}). Enter your own number if your watch knows it.
activity.kcalNoWeight: We can't estimate calories without your weight — enter the number yourself or fill in your weight under Profile.
activity.invalid: Enter a duration above 0 — and calories if they can't be estimated.

onboarding.unitsQuestion: Which units would you like to use?
onboarding.unitsHint: We picked these based on your country. You can change them anytime under Settings → Language and region.
onboarding.calendarViewQuestion: Which view should the calendar open in?
onboarding.calendarViewHint: You can change it anytime under Settings → Display → Calendar view.
onboarding.sleepPatternQuestion: Do you have a regular sleep pattern?
onboarding.shiftWorkQuestion: Is that due to varying work hours or night work?
onboarding.dailyLogQuestion: Do you want to log work hours or sleep times daily?
onboarding.healthImportQuestion: Do you want to import data from your smartwatch or health app?
onboarding.healthImportHint: Can always be set up later under personal details.

activity.introTitle: How much does your body use in a day?
activity.introBody: We work it out in three parts: what your body uses at rest, what your everyday adds, and what your exercise adds. You see the sum at the end.
activity.introNoDouble: Answer about your everyday without counting exercise — we ask about that separately so it isn't counted twice.
activity.workQuestion: What does most of your work or study day look like?

work.SITTING: Almost only sitting — e.g. office, studies, driving
work.MOSTLY_SITTING: Mostly sitting, but I walk around a bit
work.MIXED: A mix of sitting, standing and walking — e.g. teacher
work.MOSTLY_STANDING: Mostly standing or walking — e.g. shop, waiter, mechanic
work.PHYSICAL: Physically demanding — e.g. construction, farming, warehouse

activity.walkStandQuestion: How many hours do you usually walk or stand per day?
activity.walkStandHint: Think of an ordinary day like yesterday — work, shopping, housework, everything outside exercise.
activity.transportQuestion: How do you usually get around?

transport.MOTORIZED: Car or public transport almost all the way
transport.LITTLE_WALKING: A little walking to and from
transport.SOME_WALKING: A fair bit of walking every day
transport.DAILY_ACTIVE: I walk or cycle a lot every day

activity.stepsQuestion: Roughly how many steps do you take per day?
activity.stepsHint: If your phone or watch knows the number, use it. Otherwise choose "Don't know".
activity.trainingHint: Running, cycling, gym, team sports, swimming — anything you do to move.
activity.intensityHint: The talk test: how easy is it to hold a conversation while you're at it?

intensity.LIGHT: I hardly get out of breath
intensity.MODERATE: I get slightly out of breath but can talk normally
intensity.VIGOROUS: I get clearly out of breath
intensity.VERY_VIGOROUS: It's hard to hold a conversation

activity.resultSuggested: Your usual activity level looks like: {level}
activity.adjustLevel: Doesn't fit? Adjust the level here
activity.farFromSuggestion: That's quite far from what your answers suggest. Remember exercise isn't counted here — it counts separately.
activity.stepsAreExamples: Step counts are rough examples, not fixed limits.

energy.title: How we work it out
energy.range: Probably between {low} and {high} kcal — it gets more precise as the app receives weight and activity data.
energy.whyCalibrated: How we adjusted: over {days} logged days you ate {intake} kcal on average, and your trend weight changed {slope} kg/week. That points to roughly {learned} kcal. We give that {weight}% weight and the rest to the formula, so a single odd number doesn't tip the calculation.

calibrationStatus.OK: Adjusted continuously from your logs and weigh-ins.
calibrationStatus.NOT_ENOUGH_INTAKE: Once you've logged 14 days, we start adjusting the number to your weight.
calibrationStatus.NOT_ENOUGH_WEIGHT: Weigh yourself regularly over at least two weeks and we'll adjust the number to your weight.
calibrationStatus.IMPLAUSIBLE: Your logs and weigh-ins currently point too far from the formula to adjust — often because not everything was logged.

energy.whyRest: What your body uses if you lay still all day. Based on weight, height, age and sex (Mifflin-St Jeor).
energy.whyEveryday: Work, walking, standing and transport — without exercise. Your answers match the level "{level}" (PAL {pal}).
energy.whyTraining: Your typical exercise spread over the week, counted net so resting metabolism isn't counted twice. When you log a workout it replaces this allowance for that day.
energy.whyGoal: The difference between what you use and what you should eat to reach your goal at a healthy pace.
energy.disclaimer: All numbers are estimates, not measurements. They don't replace advice from a doctor or dietitian.
energy.missingData: To work out your energy needs we still need:

adjustment.CHILD_NO_DEFICIT: Under 18 we don't set a calorie deficit — the body is still growing.
adjustment.UNDERWEIGHT_NO_LOSS: Your weight is below what we consider healthy, so we don't suggest weight loss.
adjustment.TARGET_RAISED_TO_MIN_BMI: Your target weight was raised to the lowest weight we consider healthy for your height.
adjustment.PACE_CAPPED: The pace was lowered to what is healthy to lose per week.
adjustment.PACE_SLOW_NORMAL_WEIGHT: You're at a normal weight, so we keep the pace slow.
adjustment.DEFICIT_CAPPED_SHARE: The deficit is limited to 20% of your energy needs.
adjustment.FLOOR_APPLIED: The budget was raised to the lowest amount that is healthy to eat without medical supervision.
adjustment.BMR_FLOOR_APPLIED: The budget was raised so it doesn't fall below your resting metabolism.
adjustment.GAIN_PACE_CAPPED: The pace was lowered to what is healthy to gain per week.

energyGoal.title: Calorie goal
energyGoal.intro: Choose what you want for your weight. We work out a daily budget from your energy needs — always within what is healthy.
energyGoal.paceHintLose: A healthy pace for you: at most {value} per week. Faster can't be chosen.
energyGoal.paceHintGain: Slow weight gain builds the most muscle and the least fat.
energyGoal.targetRaised: We use {value} as the target — lower is below what we consider healthy for your height.
energyGoal.eta: At that pace it takes about {weeks} weeks — probably between {from} and {to}. The date moves as your weight does.
energyGoal.disclaimer: The budget is an estimate and is adjusted continuously. If pregnant, breastfeeding, ill or living with an eating disorder: talk to your doctor before following a calorie goal.

account.newsletterIntro: Hello Cal does not know your email. To receive newsletters, sign up separately — the signup is not linked to your account.
account.newsletterSent: Check your email to confirm the signup.
account.pushOnlyHint: Hello Cal does not know your email, so messages are only sent as push.

account.loginIntro: Hello Cal uses passkeys instead of passwords. You log in with Face ID, fingerprint or your device PIN.
account.loginPrivacy: Your data is encrypted on your device. Neither we nor anyone else can read it.
account.loginFailed: Could not log in with passkey
account.noPasskeySupport: Your browser does not support passkeys. Update your browser or use another device.
account.signupIntro: Enter your email. We will send you a link to create your account.
account.signupEmailNote: We do not store your email address — only an unrecognisable fingerprint of it, so you can recover access later.
account.checkMailBody: If the address is valid, we have sent you a link. It works for 30 minutes.
account.confirmIntro: Your device will now create a passkey for Hello Cal. It also unlocks your encrypted vault.
account.linkMissing: The link is invalid or has expired. Start over.
account.recoveryFileIntro: If you lose all your devices, this file is the only way back to your data. Keep it somewhere safe, e.g. in your email or a cloud folder.
account.recoveryFileWarning: Without the file, neither you nor we can open your data again.
account.recoveryFileSplit: The file only works together with the Hello Cal half, which we only release after you have confirmed your identity with support.
account.passkeyDeviceOnly: Your browser cannot use the passkey to unlock your data on other devices. The key is only stored on this device — keep the recovery file safe.
account.recoverIntro: Enter the email you created the account with. We will send you a link.
account.recoverChooseTitle: How do you want to recover?
account.haveFileNote: You open a case. Once support has confirmed your identity, you can open your data again.
account.fileInvalid: This is not a valid Hello Cal recovery file
account.noFile: I have neither a device nor the file
account.noFileNote: You can start over with an empty account. Your old data can never be opened again — not even by us.
account.startOver: Start over with an empty account
account.startOverConfirm: Are you sure? Your old data will never be accessible again.
account.caseInstructions: Contact Hello Cal support with the case number and your email. We confirm it is you and approve the case.
account.approvedIntro: The case is approved. Choose your recovery file again and create a new passkey.
account.lockedTitle: Your data is locked on this device
account.lockedBody: You are logged in, but the key to your data is not on this device. Use recovery to unlock it.
account.deleteAccountConfirm: Are you sure? Your data is deleted permanently and cannot be recovered.

helpChat.title: Help
helpChat.welcome: Hi! I'm Hello Cal's help chatbot. Ask me about the app and I'll help you along. If you'd rather talk to a person, tap "Talk to a person".
helpChat.suggestion1: How do I scan a barcode?
helpChat.suggestion2: How do I change my calorie goal?
helpChat.suggestion3: How do I cancel my subscription?
helpChat.suggestion4: The product doesn't exist – what do I do?
helpChat.offerHuman: I can't fully solve this on my own. Would you like a member of staff to look at it?
helpChat.escalateIntro: We'll send the conversation to Support so you don't have to explain it all again. You'll get a reply here in the app.
helpChat.escalateIntroEmpty: Tell us what you need help with and we'll send it to Support. You'll get a reply here in the app.
helpChat.loggedOut: Log in to chat with us. Until then, the Help centre answers the most common questions.
